updates.title: Microsoft Purview: View-Only Device Management Role for Endpoint DLP
updates.summary: A new View-Only Device Management role is being introduced to grant least-privilege access to device onboarding settings in Endpoint DLP, allowing auditors and security analysts to view device status without requiring broad admin roles. This reduces the attack surface by eliminating the need to assign Compliance Administrator or Global Administrator roles for read-only device management tasks.

updates.title: CVE-2026-109460: Microsoft Entra Private Network Connector Information Disclosure Vulnerability
updates.summary: A sensitive information exposure vulnerability in Microsoft Entra Private Network Connector allows an authorized attacker to disclose information locally. Organizations should apply the latest security patch to prevent potential unauthorized access to sensitive connector data.

updates.title: 2 Active Directory Certificate Services Vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-105590, CVE-2026-95884)
updates.summary: Two vulnerabilities affecting Windows Active Directory Certificate Services have been patched: a security feature bypass via improper certificate validation (CVE-2026-105590) and an information disclosure via buffer over-read (CVE-2026-95884). Organizations managing certificate-based authentication should prioritize applying these security updates to protect their PKI infrastructure.

updates.title: CVE-2026-70240: Windows Kerberos Denial of Service Vulnerability
updates.summary: A memory leak vulnerability in Windows Kerberos can be exploited by an unauthorized attacker to cause denial of service over the network. This impacts authentication availability across Windows environments and should be patched to maintain service continuity.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Permissions Audit Log Improvements
updates.summary: Enhanced audit logging for Purview portal access now provides clearer visibility into role and scoped-role authorization decisions, making it easier for administrators to troubleshoot access issues and monitor who accessed what and why. This strengthens the ability to audit compliance and security posture across your information governance infrastructure.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Labeling Scale Increase for SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: The maximum daily auto-labeling capacity for SharePoint and OneDrive has increased from 100,000 to 500,000 files per tenant, enabling organizations to label and protect significantly more data at rest. This accelerates data protection coverage and helps close labeling gaps across existing content estates.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Labeling Per-Policy Coverage Report
updates.summary: A new per-policy coverage report allows administrators to compare auto-labeling enforcement results against simulation snapshots, showing which files have been labeled and which remain unlabeled. This visibility helps admins track enforcement progress and identify data gaps in labeling coverage.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention Guided Diagnostics Experience
updates.summary: A new guided diagnostics tool helps users and administrators understand why DLP policies triggered on a document, including which policies matched, evaluation order, and condition-by-condition results. For E5 customers, Copilot-powered insights provide tailored remediation recommendations to accelerate troubleshooting.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Restrict Access Action for Fabric Semantic Models and Lakehouses
updates.summary: DLP policies can now block access to sensitive data in Fabric semantic models and lakehouses, with the ability to restrict access by guest users or all users based on detected sensitive information types or labels. This extends Purview's data protection controls to the Fabric analytics platform.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Archive Mailbox Auto-Expansion Beyond 1.5 TB Limit
updates.summary: Archive mailboxes can now automatically expand beyond the previous 1.5 TB limitation, eliminating operational disruption and enabling continuous retention at scale. This is available to organizations with eligible E5 licenses.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP Policy Sync & Device Health AI-Powered Investigation
updates.summary: AI-powered visibility into DLP policy deployment across devices automatically detects sync failures and unhealthy configurations, providing root-cause analysis and recommended remediation actions. This accelerates diagnosis and resolution of device-level compliance issues.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DSPM Copilot Readiness and Data Explorer
updates.summary: New readiness assessment and data explorer experiences in Data Security Posture Management provide visibility into an organization's data security posture and readiness for Microsoft Copilot, including metrics on sensitive data exposure, oversharing, and protection coverage. This helps security teams prioritize remediation efforts.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Labeling Scalability, Policy Management, and Reporting Enhancements
updates.summary: Enterprise-scale auto-labeling improvements expand support for larger SharePoint scopes, enhance policy management flexibility, and provide richer visibility into labeling activity. These enhancements enable organizations to manage sensitive data classification more effectively across their entire data estate.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP FTP and SFTP Transfer Protection
updates.summary: Endpoint DLP can now monitor sensitive data transferred over FTP and SFTP protocols and apply restrictive actions based on policy configuration. Organizations can configure these transfer activities in their Endpoint DLP policies to extend protection beyond traditional endpoints.
